plugin.name: UI_Layout_Controller
plugin.author: ChatGPT
plugin.purpose: Centers MUSHclient output and shows theme-based stretched gutter backgrounds.
plugin.description:
UI Layout Controller v1.27
Centers normal MUD output and reserves left/right gutters for miniwindow plugins.
This version supports theme-linked gutter backgrounds:
default = neon green hex HUD classic = grey stone panels (the former default) amber = amber/orange shard HUD red = automatic critical-HP alert; five random variants per side warning = automatic HP warning; five random variants per side
Legacy "green" from an older Theme Controller is treated as "default".
Put these files in the "gutters" subfolder beside this plugin XML:
UILayout_Gutter_Left_Grey.png UILayout_Gutter_Right_Grey.png UILayout_Gutter_Left_Green.png UILayout_Gutter_Right_Green.png UILayout_Gutter_Left_Amber.png UILayout_Gutter_Right_Amber.png
UILayout_Gutter_Left_Red_1.png ... Red_5.png UILayout_Gutter_Right_Red_1.png ... Red_5.png UILayout_Gutter_Left_Warning_1.png ... Warning_5.png UILayout_Gutter_Right_Warning_1.png ... Warning_5.png
Commands:
layout Show current layout/background status.
layout 390 850 Set left/right gutter widths.
layout 300 Set both gutters to 300 px.
layout on layout off
layout bg on layout bg off layout bg reload Reload the current theme's gutter PNGs from disk.
Default new-install gutters are 390 px left / 850 px right.
The miniwindow backgrounds are assigned a very low Z-order so normal tracker/plugin miniwindows should render above them.

muclient.script:
-------------------------------------------------- -- UI LAYOUT CONTROLLER v1.26 --------------------------------------------------
local THEME_CONTROLLER_ID = "43c8d047be7a418ba5e86916"
local THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE = 9042
local DEFAULT_LEFT_GUTTER = 390
local DEFAULT_RIGHT_GUTTER = 850
local MIN_TEXT_PIXELS = 560
local MIN_TEXT_COLUMNS = 72
-------------------------------------------------- -- GUTTER BACKGROUNDS --------------------------------------------------
local GUTTER_IMAGE_DIRECTORY = "gutters"
local LEFT_BG_WIN = "A_UI_LAYOUT_BACKGROUND_LEFT_" .. GetPluginID()
local RIGHT_BG_WIN = "A_UI_LAYOUT_BACKGROUND_RIGHT_" .. GetPluginID()
local LEFT_BG_IMAGE_ID = "gutter_left"
local RIGHT_BG_IMAGE_ID = "gutter_right"
local DEFAULT_LEFT_BG_FILENAME = "UILayout_Gutter_Left_Green.png"
local DEFAULT_RIGHT_BG_FILENAME = "UILayout_Gutter_Right_Green.png"
local CLASSIC_LEFT_BG_FILENAME = "UILayout_Gutter_Left_Grey.png"
local CLASSIC_RIGHT_BG_FILENAME = "UILayout_Gutter_Right_Grey.png"
local AMBER_LEFT_BG_FILENAME = "UILayout_Gutter_Left_Amber.png"
local AMBER_RIGHT_BG_FILENAME = "UILayout_Gutter_Right_Amber.png"
local RED_LEFT_BG_FILENAMES = { "UILayout_Gutter_Left_Red_1.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Left_Red_2.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Left_Red_3.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Left_Red_4.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Left_Red_5.png" }
local RED_RIGHT_BG_FILENAMES = { "UILayout_Gutter_Right_Red_1.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Right_Red_2.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Right_Red_3.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Right_Red_4.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Right_Red_5.png" }
local RED_LEFT_IMAGE_IDS = { "red_left_1", "red_left_2", "red_left_3", "red_left_4", "red_left_5" }
local RED_RIGHT_IMAGE_IDS = { "red_right_1", "red_right_2", "red_right_3", "red_right_4", "red_right_5" }
local WARNING_LEFT_BG_FILENAMES = { "UILayout_Gutter_Left_Warning_1.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Left_Warning_2.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Left_Warning_3.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Left_Warning_4.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Left_Warning_5.png" }
local WARNING_RIGHT_BG_FILENAMES = { "UILayout_Gutter_Right_Warning_1.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Right_Warning_2.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Right_Warning_3.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Right_Warning_4.png", "UILayout_Gutter_Right_Warning_5.png" }
local WARNING_LEFT_IMAGE_IDS = { "warning_left_1", "warning_left_2", "warning_left_3", "warning_left_4", "warning_left_5" }
local WARNING_RIGHT_IMAGE_IDS = { "warning_right_1", "warning_right_2", "warning_right_3", "warning_right_4", "warning_right_5" }
local BACKGROUND_Z_ORDER = -10000
local layoutEnabled = true
local backgroundEnabled = true
local configuredLeft = DEFAULT_LEFT_GUTTER
local configuredRight = DEFAULT_RIGHT_GUTTER
local effectiveLeft = 0
local effectiveRight = 0
local effectiveTextWidth = 0
local leftImageLoaded = false
local rightImageLoaded = false
local leftImagePath = ""
local rightImagePath = ""
local redLeftLoaded = {} local redRightLoaded = {}
local warningLeftLoaded = {} local warningRightLoaded = {}
local currentRedLeftIndex = nil local currentRedRightIndex = nil
local currentWarningLeftIndex = nil local currentWarningRightIndex = nil
local randomSeeded = false
-------------------------------------------------- -- SMALL HELPERS --------------------------------------------------
local function Clamp( value, low, high ) value = tonumber(value) or low
if value < low then return low end
if value > high then return high end
return value end
local function CurrentTheme() local theme = GetPluginVariable( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "effective_theme" )
if not theme or theme == "" then theme = GetPluginVariable( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "theme" ) end
theme = tostring(theme or ""):lower()
-- Backward compatibility with the old public theme name. if theme == "green" then theme = "default" end
if theme ~= "default" and theme ~= "classic" and theme ~= "amber" and theme ~= "red" and theme ~= "warning" then theme = "default" end
return theme end
local function LayoutColours() local theme = CurrentTheme()
if theme == "amber" then return ColourNameToRGB("#120B02"), ColourNameToRGB("#5A3510") elseif theme == "default" then return ColourNameToRGB("#031006"), ColourNameToRGB("#174B23") elseif theme == "red" then return ColourNameToRGB("#080000"), ColourNameToRGB("#7A1010") elseif theme == "warning" then return ColourNameToRGB("#080700"), ColourNameToRGB("#806A00") end
-- "classic" is the former default grey/stone appearance. return ColourNameToRGB("#101214"), ColourNameToRGB("#30343A") end
local function MinimumTextWidth() local fontWidth = tonumber(GetInfo(213)) or 0 local columnsWidth = fontWidth * MIN_TEXT_COLUMNS
return math.max(MIN_TEXT_PIXELS, columnsWidth) end
local function JoinPath(directory, filename) directory = directory or ""
if directory == "" then return filename end
local last = directory:sub(-1)
if last == "\\" or last == "/" then return directory .. filename end
return directory .. "\\" .. filename end
local function PluginDirectory() return GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 20) or "" end
local function DesiredBackgroundFilenames() local theme = CurrentTheme()
if theme == "classic" then return CLASSIC_LEFT_BG_FILENAME, CLASSIC_RIGHT_BG_FILENAME elseif theme == "amber" then return AMBER_LEFT_BG_FILENAME, AMBER_RIGHT_BG_FILENAME end
-- "default" is now the green terminal/HUD appearance. return DEFAULT_LEFT_BG_FILENAME, DEFAULT_RIGHT_BG_FILENAME end
-------------------------------------------------- -- SAVE / LOAD --------------------------------------------------
local function LoadLayoutState() local enabled = GetVariable("layout_enabled")
if enabled == "0" then layoutEnabled = false elseif enabled == "1" then layoutEnabled = true end
local bgEnabled = GetVariable("layout_background_enabled")
if bgEnabled == "0" then backgroundEnabled = false elseif bgEnabled == "1" then backgroundEnabled = true end
configuredLeft = Clamp( GetVariable("layout_left") or DEFAULT_LEFT_GUTTER, 0, 2000 )
configuredRight = Clamp( GetVariable("layout_right") or DEFAULT_RIGHT_GUTTER, 0, 2000 ) end
local function SaveLayoutState() SetVariable( "layout_enabled", layoutEnabled and "1" or "0" )
SetVariable( "layout_background_enabled", backgroundEnabled and "1" or "0" )
SetVariable( "layout_left", tostring(configuredLeft) )
SetVariable( "layout_right", tostring(configuredRight) ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- BACKGROUND MINIWINDOWS --------------------------------------------------
local function HideBackgroundWindows() WindowShow(LEFT_BG_WIN, false) WindowShow(RIGHT_BG_WIN, false) end
local function EnsureBackgroundWindows() local fillColour = select(1, LayoutColours())
if not WindowInfo(LEFT_BG_WIN, 3) then WindowCreate( LEFT_BG_WIN, 0, 0, 1, 1, miniwin.pos_top_left, miniwin.create_absolute_location + miniwin.create_ignore_mouse, fillColour ) end
if not WindowInfo(RIGHT_BG_WIN, 3) then WindowCreate( RIGHT_BG_WIN, 0, 0, 1, 1, miniwin.pos_top_left, miniwin.create_absolute_location + miniwin.create_ignore_mouse, fillColour ) end
WindowSetZOrder(LEFT_BG_WIN, BACKGROUND_Z_ORDER) WindowSetZOrder(RIGHT_BG_WIN, BACKGROUND_Z_ORDER) end
local function TryLoadImage(win, imageId, path) return WindowLoadImage(win, imageId, path) == 0 end
local function SeedRandom() if randomSeeded then return end
randomSeeded = true
math.randomseed( os.time() + math.floor( os.clock() * 100000 ) )
math.random() math.random() math.random() end
local function LoadRedBackgroundImages(announceErrors) EnsureBackgroundWindows()
local directory = JoinPath( PluginDirectory(), GUTTER_IMAGE_DIRECTORY )
for i = 1, 5 do local leftPath = JoinPath( directory, RED_LEFT_BG_FILENAMES[i] )
local rightPath = JoinPath( directory, RED_RIGHT_BG_FILENAMES[i] )
redLeftLoaded[i] = TryLoadImage( LEFT_BG_WIN, RED_LEFT_IMAGE_IDS[i], leftPath )
redRightLoaded[i] = TryLoadImage( RIGHT_BG_WIN, RED_RIGHT_IMAGE_IDS[i], rightPath )
if announceErrors and not redLeftLoaded[i] then ColourNote( "red", "", "UI layout: could not load RED left image: " .. leftPath ) end
if announceErrors and not redRightLoaded[i] then ColourNote( "red", "", "UI layout: could not load RED right image: " .. rightPath ) end end end
local function LoadWarningBackgroundImages(announceErrors) EnsureBackgroundWindows()
local directory = JoinPath( PluginDirectory(), GUTTER_IMAGE_DIRECTORY )
for i = 1, 5 do local leftPath = JoinPath( directory, WARNING_LEFT_BG_FILENAMES[i] )
local rightPath = JoinPath( directory, WARNING_RIGHT_BG_FILENAMES[i] )
warningLeftLoaded[i] = TryLoadImage( LEFT_BG_WIN, WARNING_LEFT_IMAGE_IDS[i], leftPath )
warningRightLoaded[i] = TryLoadImage( RIGHT_BG_WIN, WARNING_RIGHT_IMAGE_IDS[i], rightPath )
if announceErrors and not warningLeftLoaded[i] then ColourNote( "red", "", "UI layout: could not load WARNING left image: " .. leftPath ) end
if announceErrors and not warningRightLoaded[i] then ColourNote( "red", "", "UI layout: could not load WARNING right image: " .. rightPath ) end end end
local function ChooseRandomLoadedIndex( loaded, current ) local choices = {}
for i = 1, 5 do if loaded[i] and i ~= current then table.insert( choices, i ) end end
if #choices == 0 then for i = 1, 5 do if loaded[i] then table.insert( choices, i ) end end end
if #choices == 0 then return nil end
return choices[ math.random( 1, #choices ) ] end
local function SelectRandomRedPair() SeedRandom()
currentRedLeftIndex = ChooseRandomLoadedIndex( redLeftLoaded, currentRedLeftIndex )
currentRedRightIndex = ChooseRandomLoadedIndex( redRightLoaded, currentRedRightIndex ) end
local function SelectRandomWarningPair() SeedRandom()
currentWarningLeftIndex = ChooseRandomLoadedIndex( warningLeftLoaded, currentWarningLeftIndex )
currentWarningRightIndex = ChooseRandomLoadedIndex( warningRightLoaded, currentWarningRightIndex ) end
local function LoadBackgroundImages(announceErrors) EnsureBackgroundWindows()
local directory = JoinPath( PluginDirectory(), GUTTER_IMAGE_DIRECTORY ) local desiredLeft, desiredRight = DesiredBackgroundFilenames()
if CurrentTheme() == "red" or CurrentTheme() == "warning" then desiredLeft = CLASSIC_LEFT_BG_FILENAME
desiredRight = CLASSIC_RIGHT_BG_FILENAME end
leftImagePath = JoinPath(directory, desiredLeft) rightImagePath = JoinPath(directory, desiredRight)
leftImageLoaded = TryLoadImage(LEFT_BG_WIN, LEFT_BG_IMAGE_ID, leftImagePath) rightImageLoaded = TryLoadImage(RIGHT_BG_WIN, RIGHT_BG_IMAGE_ID, rightImagePath)
if not leftImageLoaded and desiredLeft ~= DEFAULT_LEFT_BG_FILENAME then leftImagePath = JoinPath(directory, DEFAULT_LEFT_BG_FILENAME) leftImageLoaded = TryLoadImage(LEFT_BG_WIN, LEFT_BG_IMAGE_ID, leftImagePath) end
if not rightImageLoaded and desiredRight ~= DEFAULT_RIGHT_BG_FILENAME then rightImagePath = JoinPath(directory, DEFAULT_RIGHT_BG_FILENAME) rightImageLoaded = TryLoadImage(RIGHT_BG_WIN, RIGHT_BG_IMAGE_ID, rightImagePath) end
if announceErrors then if not leftImageLoaded then ColourNote( "red", "", "UI layout: could not load left gutter image: " .. leftImagePath ) end
if not rightImageLoaded then ColourNote( "red", "", "UI layout: could not load right gutter image: " .. rightImagePath ) end end end
local function DrawImageStretched(win, imageId, width, height) if width <= 0 or height <= 0 then return end
local imageWidth = tonumber(WindowImageInfo(win, imageId, 2)) or 0 local imageHeight = tonumber(WindowImageInfo(win, imageId, 3)) or 0
if imageWidth <= 0 or imageHeight <= 0 then return end
WindowDrawImage( win, imageId, 0, 0, width, height, miniwin.image_stretch, 0, 0, imageWidth, imageHeight ) end
local function DrawGutterBackgrounds(outputWidth, outputHeight) EnsureBackgroundWindows()
if not layoutEnabled or not backgroundEnabled then HideBackgroundWindows() return end
local fillColour = select(1, LayoutColours())
if effectiveLeft > 0 then WindowResize(LEFT_BG_WIN, effectiveLeft, outputHeight, fillColour) WindowPosition( LEFT_BG_WIN, 0, 0, miniwin.pos_top_left, miniwin.create_absolute_location + miniwin.create_ignore_mouse ) WindowRectOp(LEFT_BG_WIN, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, effectiveLeft, outputHeight, fillColour)
if CurrentTheme() == "red" and currentRedLeftIndex and redLeftLoaded[ currentRedLeftIndex ] then DrawImageStretched( LEFT_BG_WIN, RED_LEFT_IMAGE_IDS[ currentRedLeftIndex ], effectiveLeft, outputHeight )
elseif CurrentTheme() == "warning" and currentWarningLeftIndex and warningLeftLoaded[ currentWarningLeftIndex ] then DrawImageStretched( LEFT_BG_WIN, WARNING_LEFT_IMAGE_IDS[ currentWarningLeftIndex ], effectiveLeft, outputHeight )
elseif leftImageLoaded then DrawImageStretched( LEFT_BG_WIN, LEFT_BG_IMAGE_ID, effectiveLeft, outputHeight ) end
WindowSetZOrder(LEFT_BG_WIN, BACKGROUND_Z_ORDER) WindowShow(LEFT_BG_WIN, true) else WindowShow(LEFT_BG_WIN, false) end
if effectiveRight > 0 then WindowResize(RIGHT_BG_WIN, effectiveRight, outputHeight, fillColour) WindowPosition( RIGHT_BG_WIN, outputWidth - effectiveRight, 0, miniwin.pos_top_left, miniwin.create_absolute_location + miniwin.create_ignore_mouse ) WindowRectOp(RIGHT_BG_WIN, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, effectiveRight, outputHeight, fillColour)
if CurrentTheme() == "red" and currentRedRightIndex and redRightLoaded[ currentRedRightIndex ] then DrawImageStretched( RIGHT_BG_WIN, RED_RIGHT_IMAGE_IDS[ currentRedRightIndex ], effectiveRight, outputHeight )
elseif CurrentTheme() == "warning" and currentWarningRightIndex and warningRightLoaded[ currentWarningRightIndex ] then DrawImageStretched( RIGHT_BG_WIN, WARNING_RIGHT_IMAGE_IDS[ currentWarningRightIndex ], effectiveRight, outputHeight )
elseif rightImageLoaded then DrawImageStretched( RIGHT_BG_WIN, RIGHT_BG_IMAGE_ID, effectiveRight, outputHeight ) end
WindowSetZOrder(RIGHT_BG_WIN, BACKGROUND_Z_ORDER) WindowShow(RIGHT_BG_WIN, true) else WindowShow(RIGHT_BG_WIN, false) end end
-------------------------------------------------- -- TEXT RECTANGLE --------------------------------------------------
function ApplyLayout() if not GetInfo(285) then return end
if not layoutEnabled then TextRectangle(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) effectiveLeft = 0 effectiveRight = 0 effectiveTextWidth = tonumber(GetInfo(281)) or 0 HideBackgroundWindows() return end
local outputHeight = tonumber(GetInfo(280)) or 0 local outputWidth = tonumber(GetInfo(281)) or 0
if outputWidth <= 0 or outputHeight <= 0 then return end
local left = configuredLeft local right = configuredRight
local minimumText = math.min( MinimumTextWidth(), math.max(240, outputWidth) )
local availableForGutters = math.max(0, outputWidth - minimumText) local requestedGutters = left + right
if requestedGutters > availableForGutters and requestedGutters > 0 then local scale = availableForGutters / requestedGutters left = math.floor(left * scale) right = math.floor(right * scale) end
local rightEdge = outputWidth - right
if rightEdge <= left then rightEdge = left + 1 end
local fillColour, borderColour = LayoutColours()
TextRectangle( left, 0, rightEdge, outputHeight, 0, borderColour, 0, fillColour, 0 )
effectiveLeft = left effectiveRight = right effectiveTextWidth = rightEdge - left
DrawGutterBackgrounds(outputWidth, outputHeight) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- COMMANDS --------------------------------------------------
local function PrintLayout() if not layoutEnabled then ColourNote("yellow", "", "UI layout: OFF (normal full-width output)") ColourNote("gray", "", "Saved gutters: left " .. configuredLeft .. " px, right " .. configuredRight .. " px") return end
ColourNote("yellow", "", "UI layout: ON") ColourNote("gray", "", "Theme: " .. CurrentTheme()) ColourNote("gray", "", "Configured gutters: left " .. configuredLeft .. " px, right " .. configuredRight .. " px") ColourNote( "gray", "", "Current effective gutters: left " .. effectiveLeft .. " px, right " .. effectiveRight .. " px; MUD text width " .. effectiveTextWidth .. " px" ) ColourNote("gray", "", "Gutter backgrounds: " .. (backgroundEnabled and "ON" or "OFF"))
if backgroundEnabled then ColourNote( leftImageLoaded and "green" or "red", "", "Left image: " .. (leftImageLoaded and "loaded" or "NOT loaded") .. " - " .. leftImagePath ) ColourNote( rightImageLoaded and "green" or "red", "", "Right image: " .. (rightImageLoaded and "loaded" or "NOT loaded") .. " - " .. rightImagePath ) end
ColourNote( "gray", "", "Commands: layout <both> | layout <left> <right> | layout off/on | layout bg off/on/reload" ) end
function LayoutStatus(name, line, wildcards) ApplyLayout() PrintLayout() end
function LayoutOff(name, line, wildcards) layoutEnabled = false SaveLayoutState() ApplyLayout() ColourNote("yellow", "", "UI layout disabled.") end
function LayoutOn(name, line, wildcards) layoutEnabled = true SaveLayoutState() ApplyLayout() ColourNote( "yellow", "", "UI layout enabled: " .. configuredLeft .. " px left / " .. configuredRight .. " px right." ) end
function LayoutSymmetric(name, line, wildcards) local gutter = Clamp(wildcards[1], 0, 2000) configuredLeft = gutter configuredRight = gutter layoutEnabled = true SaveLayoutState() ApplyLayout() ColourNote("yellow", "", "UI layout: " .. gutter .. " px on both sides.") end
function LayoutAsymmetric(name, line, wildcards) configuredLeft = Clamp(wildcards[1], 0, 2000) configuredRight = Clamp(wildcards[2], 0, 2000) layoutEnabled = true SaveLayoutState() ApplyLayout() ColourNote( "yellow", "", "UI layout: " .. configuredLeft .. " px left / " .. configuredRight .. " px right." ) end
function LayoutBackgroundOn(name, line, wildcards) backgroundEnabled = true SaveLayoutState() LoadBackgroundImages(true) ApplyLayout() ColourNote("yellow", "", "UI gutter backgrounds enabled.") end
function LayoutBackgroundOff(name, line, wildcards) backgroundEnabled = false SaveLayoutState() HideBackgroundWindows() ColourNote("yellow", "", "UI gutter backgrounds disabled.") end
function LayoutBackgroundReload(name, line, wildcards) LoadRedBackgroundImages(true) LoadWarningBackgroundImages(true) LoadBackgroundImages(true)
if CurrentTheme() == "red" then SelectRandomRedPair() elseif CurrentTheme() == "warning" then SelectRandomWarningPair() end
ApplyLayout() ColourNote("yellow", "", "UI gutter background images reloaded.") end
-------------------------------------------------- -- RED ALERT ANIMATION --------------------------------------------------
function HealthAlertAnimationTick()
local theme = CurrentTheme()
if ( theme ~= "red" and theme ~= "warning" ) or not layoutEnabled or not backgroundEnabled then return end
if theme == "red" then SelectRandomRedPair() else SelectRandomWarningPair() end
ApplyLayout() end
-------------------------------------------------- -- CALLBACKS --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginInstall() LoadLayoutState() SaveLayoutState() EnsureBackgroundWindows() SeedRandom() LoadRedBackgroundImages(true) LoadWarningBackgroundImages(true) LoadBackgroundImages(true)
if CurrentTheme() == "red" then SelectRandomRedPair() elseif CurrentTheme() == "warning" then SelectRandomWarningPair() end
ApplyLayout() end
function OnPluginEnable() LoadLayoutState() EnsureBackgroundWindows() SeedRandom() LoadRedBackgroundImages(false) LoadWarningBackgroundImages(false) LoadBackgroundImages(false)
if CurrentTheme() == "red" then SelectRandomRedPair() elseif CurrentTheme() == "warning" then SelectRandomWarningPair() end
ApplyLayout() end
function OnPluginDisable() HideBackgroundWindows() TextRectangle(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) end
function OnPluginClose() HideBackgroundWindows() TextRectangle(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) end
function OnPluginSaveState() SaveLayoutState() end
function OnPluginWorldOutputResized() ApplyLayout() end
function OnPluginBroadcast(msg, id, name, text) if msg ~= THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE or id ~= THEME_CONTROLLER_ID then return end
LoadBackgroundImages(false)
if CurrentTheme() == "red" then SelectRandomRedPair()
currentWarningLeftIndex = nil currentWarningRightIndex = nil
elseif CurrentTheme() == "warning" then SelectRandomWarningPair()
currentRedLeftIndex = nil currentRedRightIndex = nil
else currentRedLeftIndex = nil currentRedRightIndex = nil
currentWarningLeftIndex = nil currentWarningRightIndex = nil end
ApplyLayout() end
-------------------------------------------------- -- PLUGIN CONTROLLER GUTTER API --------------------------------------------------
function GetManagedGutterLayout() return tostring(math.floor(configuredLeft)) .. "\t" .. tostring(math.floor(configuredRight)) end
function ApplyManagedGutterLayout(spec) local left, right = tostring(spec or ""):match("^(-?%d+)%s+(-?%d+)$")
left = tonumber(left) right = tonumber(right)
if not left or not right then return "invalid gutter layout" end
configuredLeft = Clamp(left, 0, 2000) configuredRight = Clamp(right, 0, 2000) layoutEnabled = true
SaveLayoutState() ApplyLayout() pcall(SaveState)
return "ok" end
